verdict.rationale: Brex publishes an OpenAPI-based API reference covering transactions, budgets, expenses, payments, webhooks and onboarding. It also maintains an official Postman developer workspace with collections for all Brex APIs, which gives runnable requests. However, nothing shows the reference itself is interactive (no in-page 'try it' console or embedded runnable code samples), and the probe found no publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: in-docs interactive try-it console, runnable code examples embedded in the reference, a publicly downloadable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
